summary:
Cash App is the payment app at cash.app. The green dollar mark in the tab is the icon payment links use, measured from the file that host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against cash.app. HTML came from https://cash.app/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://cash.app/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 1150 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://cash.app/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #00cc33 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 5465 bytes) from https://cash.app/apple-touch-icon.png.
